name: Creditor Jackie
source: Creditor Jackie. She’s a tough woman, with far too much paperwork, and a whole lot of unspent wanderlust. Every story about how she lost her limbs seems more fantastical than the last! She probably made up a few of them for the fun of it. She’ll be happy just as soon as someone pays off the “Mutiny!!” bloody debt.
